verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm, not a software product that users operate directly, so user-run bulk operations across many items is a category error for this kind of product. The firm's mentions of legal tech, digital workflows and the software-supported ySolutions register-filing service describe how it delivers its own services, not a user-facing tool. The probes found no public API surface either, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.
